evals.prompt: What should I write next? https://thepipeandtheline.substack.com
evals.success_criteria: Loads content-ideas first and checks every proposed topic against published articles with search_articles before presenting it.
evals.rubric: The answer proposes 3 article ideas, each with a headline, angle, the data that inspired it, and a coverage check saying whether it is a new topic or a follow-up to an existing article.
